const readmeConfig = {
    name: "scroll-loader",
    summary: "<h1>ScrollLoader</h1>\n<p>基于 IntersectionObserver 的 React 滚动加载组件库，当用户滚动到列表底部时自动加载更多数据，实现无限滚动体验。</p>\n<h3>核心特性</h3>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>两种加载模式</strong>：<code>ScrollLoader</code> 提供基础滚动监听能力，需配合 <code>@kne/react-fetch</code> 手动管理分页；<code>FetchScrollLoader</code> 内置数据获取与分页逻辑，开箱即用</li>\n<li><strong>智能哨兵检测</strong>：使用 IntersectionObserver 监听底部元素，内容不足一屏时自动补加载，直到填满可视区域</li>\n<li><strong>双滚动方案</strong>：默认集成 SimpleBar 美化滚动条，也支持原生 div 滚动</li>\n<li><strong>国际化内置</strong>：自带中英文支持，加载完成提示自动适配语言</li>\n<li><strong>灵活的分页配置</strong>：支持自定义分页参数字段名、每页条数、数据合并策略</li>\n<li><strong>搜索联动</strong>：<code>FetchScrollLoader</code> 支持 <code>searchProps</code> 变化时自动重置并重新加载</li>\n</ul>",
    description: "滚动加载下一页数据.",
    packageName: "@kne/scroll-loader",
    api: "<h3>ScrollLoader</h3>\n<p>基础的滚动加载组件，通过 IntersectionObserver 监听底部哨兵元素，当哨兵进入视口时触发 <code>onLoader</code> 回调加载更多数据。支持 SimpleBar 自定义滚动容器和原生滚动两种模式。</p>\n<h4>属性</h4>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>属性</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>默认值</th>\n<th>说明</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>className</td>\n<td><code>string</code></td>\n<td>—</td>\n<td>自定义 CSS 类名，会添加到滚动容器上</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>noMore</td>\n<td><code>boolean</code></td>\n<td>—</td>\n<td>是否已无更多数据，设为 <code>true</code> 后停止触发加载</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>onLoader</td>\n<td><code>() =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;</code></td>\n<td>—</td>\n<td>触发加载的回调函数，支持异步操作</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>isLoading</td>\n<td><code>boolean</code></td>\n<td>—</td>\n<td>是否正在加载中，加载中时显示 Spin 且不重复触发</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>completeTips</td>\n<td><code>string</code></td>\n<td><code>\"已加载全部数据\"</code></td>\n<td>全部数据加载完毕后的提示文案</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>maxFullCount</td>\n<td><code>number</code></td>\n<td><code>3</code></td>\n<td>内容不足以产生滚动条时，自动加载的最大次数</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>useSimpleBar</td>\n<td><code>boolean</code></td>\n<td><code>true</code></td>\n<td>是否使用 SimpleBar 作为滚动容器；<code>false</code> 则使用原生 div 滚动</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>children</td>\n<td><code>ReactNode</code></td>\n<td>—</td>\n<td>列表内容，通常为数据渲染结果</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<hr>\n<h3>FetchScrollLoader</h3>\n<p>集成了 <code>@kne/react-fetch</code> 数据获取能力的滚动加载组件，封装了分页逻辑，通过配置即可实现滚动分页加载，无需手动管理 Fetch 和分页状态。</p>\n<h4>属性</h4>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>属性</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>默认值</th>\n<th>说明</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>api</td>\n<td><code>object</code></td>\n<td><code>{ loader: () =&gt; ({ pageData: [], totalCount: 0 }) }</code></td>\n<td>数据请求配置，<code>loader</code> 函数接收请求参数，返回 <code>{ pageData, totalCount }</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>dataFormat</td>\n<td><code>(data) =&gt; ({ list, total })</code></td>\n<td><code>data =&gt; ({ list: data.pageData, total: data.totalCount })</code></td>\n<td>将接口返回数据格式化为 <code>{ list, total }</code> 结构</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>mergeList</td>\n<td><code>(data, newData) =&gt; newData</code></td>\n<td>按 <code>pageData</code> 拼接合并</td>\n<td>新旧数据合并策略，默认将 <code>pageData</code> 数组拼接</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>searchProps</td>\n<td><code>object</code></td>\n<td>—</td>\n<td>传递给接口的搜索条件，变化时重新请求第一页</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>getSearchProps</td>\n<td><code>(searchProps) =&gt; object</code></td>\n<td>—</td>\n<td>将 <code>searchProps</code> 转换为实际请求参数，返回空对象时不发起请求</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>children</td>\n<td><code>({ fetchApi, list, data }) =&gt; ReactNode</code></td>\n<td>—</td>\n<td>列表渲染函数，<code>list</code> 为格式化后的列表数据</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>render</td>\n<td><code>({ fetchApi, children }) =&gt; ReactNode</code></td>\n<td><code>({ children }) =&gt; children</code></td>\n<td>外层渲染插槽，可在 ScrollLoader 外部包裹额外 UI</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>pagination</td>\n<td><code>object</code></td>\n<td>见下方子属性</td>\n<td>分页参数配置</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>loading</td>\n<td><code>ReactNode</code></td>\n<td>—</td>\n<td>自定义加载中展示</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>error</td>\n<td><code>ReactNode</code></td>\n<td>—</td>\n<td>自定义错误状态展示</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p>另外还支持透传 <code>ScrollLoader</code> 的所有属性（如 <code>className</code>、<code>completeTips</code>、<code>maxFullCount</code>、<code>useSimpleBar</code> 等）。</p>\n<h4>pagination 子属性</h4>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>属性</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>默认值</th>\n<th>说明</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>paramsType</td>\n<td><code>string</code></td>\n<td><code>'data'</code></td>\n<td>分页参数在请求对象中的键名</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>current</td>\n<td><code>string</code></td>\n<td><code>'currentPage'</code></td>\n<td>当前页码的字段名</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>pageSizeName</td>\n<td><code>string</code></td>\n<td><code>'perPage'</code></td>\n<td>每页条数的字段名</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>pageSize</td>\n<td><code>number</code></td>\n<td><code>20</code></td>\n<td>每页数据条数</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>",
    example: {
        isFull: false,
        className: "scroll_loader_f2ee2",
        style: ".kne-responsive-boundary {\n  position: relative;\n  transform: translateZ(0);\n}\n\n.kne-responsive-scroll {\n  overflow: auto;\n}\n\n:root {\n  --kne-viewport-width: 100vw;\n  --kne-viewport-height: 100vh;\n  --kne-viewport-inline-size: 100vw;\n  --kne-viewport-block-size: 100vh;\n}\n\n.kne-responsive-boundary {\n  --kne-viewport-width: 100vw;\n  --kne-viewport-height: 100vh;\n  --kne-viewport-inline-size: 100vw;\n  --kne-viewport-block-size: 100vh;\n}\n\n@media (min-width: 769px) {\n  .scroll_loader_f2ee2 .scroll-list {\n    max-height: 500px;\n  }\n}",
        list: [{
    title: "ScrollLoader",
    description: "基础滚动加载组件，结合 Fetch 手动管理分页逻辑；移动端自动使用视口滚动，桌面端使用 SimpleBar 容器滚动",
    code: "const { get, merge, range } = lodash;\nconst { default: Fetch } = _reactFetch;\nconst { default: ScrollLoader } = _ScrollLoader;\nconst { useIsMobile } = _ResponsiveUtils;\nconst { Flex, Switch, Typography, Divider, Tag } = antd;\nconst { useState } = React;\n\nconst { Text } = Typography;\n\n// 模拟商品列表数据\nconst mockProductList = ({ currentPage = 1, perPage = 20 }) => {\n  return new Promise((resolve) => {\n    const start = (currentPage - 1) * perPage;\n    setTimeout(() => {\n      resolve({\n        totalCount: 75,\n        pageData: range(start, Math.min(start + perPage, 75)).map((key) => ({\n          id: key + 1,\n          name: `商品名称 ${key + 1}`,\n          price: (Math.random() * 1000 + 10).toFixed(2),\n          category: ['电子产品', '服装', '食品', '家居'][key % 4],\n          stock: Math.floor(Math.random() * 500),\n          status: key % 3 === 0 ? '缺货' : '在售'\n        }))\n      });\n    }, 800);\n  });\n};\n\nconst BaseExample = () => {\n  const isMobile = useIsMobile();\n  const useSimpleBar = !isMobile;\n  const [customTips, setCustomTips] = useState(false);\n\n  return (\n    <Flex vertical gap={16}>\n      <Flex gap={16} align=\"center\" style={{ padding: '0 8px' }} wrap=\"wrap\">\n        <Text strong>配置项：</Text>\n        <Tag color={isMobile ? 'orange' : 'blue'}>\n          {isMobile ? '移动端：视口滚动' : '桌面端：SimpleBar 容器滚动'}\n        </Tag>\n        <Flex align=\"center\" gap={8}>\n          <Text type=\"secondary\">自定义完成提示</Text>\n          <Switch checked={customTips} onChange={setCustomTips} />\n        </Flex>\n      </Flex>\n\n      <Divider style={{ margin: 0 }} />\n\n      <Fetch\n        loader={({ data }) => {\n          return mockProductList(Object.assign({ currentPage: 1, perPage: 20 }, data));\n        }}\n        render={(fetchApi) => {\n          const pagination = {\n            paramsType: 'data',\n            current: 'currentPage',\n            pageSize: 'perPage',\n            defaultPageSize: 20\n          };\n          const current = get(fetchApi.requestParams, [pagination.paramsType, pagination.current], 1);\n          const pageSize =\n            get(fetchApi.requestParams, [pagination.paramsType, pagination.pageSize]) ||\n            pagination.defaultPageSize;\n\n          const formatData = {\n            list: fetchApi.data.pageData,\n            total: fetchApi.data.totalCount\n          };\n\n          return (\n            <ScrollLoader\n              className=\"scroll-list\"\n              isLoading={!fetchApi.isComplete}\n              noMore={!formatData.total || current * pageSize >= formatData.total}\n              completeTips={customTips ? '— 已展示全部商品 —' : undefined}\n              maxFullCount={3}\n              useSimpleBar={useSimpleBar}\n              onLoader={async () => {\n                await fetchApi.loadMore(\n                  merge({\n                    data: {\n                      [pagination.pageSize]: pageSize,\n                      [pagination.current]: current + 1\n                    }\n                  }),\n                  (data, newData) => {\n                    return Object.assign({}, newData, {\n                      pageData: data.pageData.concat(newData.pageData)\n                    });\n                  }\n                );\n              }}\n            >\n              <Flex vertical gap={8}>\n                {formatData.list.map((item) => (\n                  <Flex\n                    key={item.id}\n                    justify=\"space-between\"\n                    align=\"center\"\n                    style={{\n                      padding: '12px 16px',\n                      background: '#fafafa',\n                      borderRadius: 8,\n                      border: '1px solid #f0f0f0'\n                    }}\n                  >\n                    <Flex vertical gap={4}>\n                      <Text strong>{item.name}</Text>\n                      <Flex gap={8}>\n                        <Tag color=\"blue\">{item.category}</Tag>\n                        <Text type=\"secondary\">库存：{item.stock}</Text>\n                      </Flex>\n                    </Flex>\n                    <Flex align=\"center\" gap={12}>\n                      <Tag color={item.status === '在售' ? 'green' : 'red'}>{item.status}</Tag>\n                      <Text strong style={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#ff4d4f' }}>\n                        ¥{item.price}\n                      </Text>\n                    </Flex>\n                  </Flex>\n                ))}\n              </Flex>\n            </ScrollLoader>\n          );\n        }}\n      />\n    </Flex>\n  );\n};\n\nrender(<BaseExample />);\n\n",

    title: "FetchScrollLoader",
    description: "集成数据获取的滚动加载组件，支持搜索过滤、自定义分页；移动端自动使用视口滚动加载",
    code: "const { FetchScrollLoader } = _ScrollLoader;\nconst { useIsMobile } = _ResponsiveUtils;\nconst { Flex, Typography, Divider, Tag, Input, Select } = antd;\nconst { useState, useCallback } = React;\n\nconst { Text, Title } = Typography;\n\n// 模拟用户列表接口\nconst mockUserList = ({ data = {} }) => {\n  const { currentPage = 1, perPage = 20, keyword, role } = data;\n  return new Promise((resolve) => {\n    const roles = ['管理员', '编辑', '普通用户'];\n    const allUsers = Array.from({ length: 86 }, (_, i) => ({\n      id: i + 1,\n      name: `用户_${String(i + 1).padStart(3, '0')}`,\n      email: `user${i + 1}@example.com`,\n      role: roles[i % 3],\n      department: ['技术部', '产品部', '设计部', '运营部'][i % 4],\n      createTime: `2024-${String((i % 12) + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String((i % 28) + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`\n    }));\n\n    let filtered = allUsers;\n    if (keyword) {\n      filtered = filtered.filter(\n        (u) => u.name.includes(keyword) || u.email.includes(keyword)\n      );\n    }\n    if (role) {\n      filtered = filtered.filter((u) => u.role === role);\n    }\n\n    const start = (currentPage - 1) * perPage;\n    const pageData = filtered.slice(start, start + perPage);\n\n    setTimeout(() => {\n      resolve({\n        totalCount: filtered.length,\n        pageData\n      });\n    }, 600);\n  });\n};\n\nconst BaseExample = () => {\n  const isMobile = useIsMobile();\n  const useSimpleBar = !isMobile;\n  const [keyword, setKeyword] = useState('');\n  const [role, setRole] = useState(undefined);\n\n  const handleSearch = useCallback((value) => {\n    setKeyword(value);\n  }, []);\n\n  return (\n    <Flex vertical gap={16}>\n      {/* 搜索区域 */}\n      <Flex gap={12} align=\"center\" style={{ padding: '0 8px' }} wrap=\"wrap\">\n        <Text strong>搜索条件：</Text>\n        <Tag color={isMobile ? 'orange' : 'blue'}>\n          {isMobile ? '移动端：视口滚动' : '桌面端：SimpleBar 容器滚动'}\n        </Tag>\n        <Input.Search\n          placeholder=\"搜索用户名或邮箱\"\n          allowClear\n          onSearch={handleSearch}\n          style={{ width: 260 }}\n        />\n        <Select\n          placeholder=\"按角色筛选\"\n          allowClear\n          value={role}\n          onChange={setRole}\n          style={{ width: 140 }}\n          options={[\n            { label: '管理员', value: '管理员' },\n            { label: '编辑', value: '编辑' },\n            { label: '普通用户', value: '普通用户' }\n          ]}\n        />\n      </Flex>\n\n      <Divider style={{ margin: 0 }} />\n\n      {/* 列表区域 */}\n      <FetchScrollLoader\n        className=\"scroll-list\"\n        useSimpleBar={useSimpleBar}\n        api={{\n          loader: mockUserList\n        }}\n        searchProps={{ keyword, role }}\n        getSearchProps={(props) => {\n          const result = {};\n          if (props.keyword) result.keyword = props.keyword;\n          if (props.role) result.role = props.role;\n          return result;\n        }}\n        pagination={{\n          paramsType: 'data',\n          current: 'currentPage',\n          pageSizeName: 'perPage',\n          pageSize: 15\n        }}\n        maxFullCount={2}\n        completeTips=\"— 已加载全部用户 —\"\n        render={({ fetchApi, children }) => {\n          return (\n            <Flex vertical gap={8}>\n              <Flex justify=\"space-between\" align=\"center\" style={{ padding: '0 4px' }}>\n                <Text type=\"secondary\">\n                  共 {fetchApi.data.totalCount} 条记录\n                </Text>\n                <Text type=\"secondary\">\n                  当前 {fetchApi.data.pageData.length} 条\n                </Text>\n              </Flex>\n              {children}\n            </Flex>\n          );\n        }}\n      >\n        {({ list }) => {\n          if (!list || list.length === 0) {\n            return (\n              <Flex justify=\"center\" style={{ padding: 40 }}>\n                <Text type=\"secondary\">暂无数据</Text>\n              </Flex>\n            );\n          }\n          return (\n            <Flex vertical gap={8}>\n              {list.map((item) => (\n                <Flex\n                  key={item.id}\n                  justify=\"space-between\"\n                  align=\"center\"\n                  style={{\n                    padding: '12px 16px',\n                    background: '#fafafa',\n                    borderRadius: 8,\n                    border: '1px solid #f0f0f0'\n                  }}\n                >\n                  <Flex vertical gap={4}>\n                    <Flex align=\"center\" gap={8}>\n                      <Text strong>{item.name}</Text>\n                      <Tag\n                        color={\n                          item.role === '管理员'\n                            ? 'red'\n                            : item.role === '编辑'\n                              ? 'blue'\n                              : 'default'\n                        }\n                      >\n                        {item.role}\n                      </Tag>\n                    </Flex>\n                    <Flex gap={16}>\n                      <Text type=\"secondary\" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>\n                        {item.email}\n                      </Text>\n                      <Text type=\"secondary\" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>\n                        {item.department}\n                      </Text>\n                    </Flex>\n                  </Flex>\n                  <Text type=\"secondary\" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>\n                    创建于 {item.createTime}\n                  </Text>\n                </Flex>\n              ))}\n            </Flex>\n          );\n        }}\n      </FetchScrollLoader>\n    </Flex>\n  );\n};\n\nrender(<BaseExample />);\n\n",
